answer: Require every agent identity to lock a slashable bond for a long vesting period before it can earn: like timber that must season before it bears weight, trust grows only with time. If peers prove one operator runs many fake identities, the bonds of all linked identities are slashed at once, so the summit of influence costs the attacker the bond many times over while an honest agent pays once, and a single vine of fake accounts cannot strangle the economy.
